title: Write Unit & E2E Tests for a Feedback Form
description: Test a feedback form with React Testing Library and Playwright to ensure it submits and displays success.
problemStatement: ## Goal You will write both a unit test (Jest + React Testing Library) and an E2E test (Playwright) for a feedback form component that submits a message and shows a success message. ### Requirements 1. **Component**: Create a client component `FeedbackForm.js` that: - Has a `
hints: Use `screen.getByPlaceholderText('Your feedback')` to find the textarea.
For the unit test, make sure the component accepts an `onSubmit` prop; you can make it optional and just set the success message directly.
In the Playwright config, set the `baseURL` to `http://localhost:3000` for convenience.
expectedOutput: All tests pass: unit test verifies success message appears; E2E test runs in browser and confirms the full flow works.
